title: Chapter 1051
text:
Boom!

Under the barrage of countless cannons, not a single piece of armor could escape the fate of annihilation. Not even a single piece of wreckage was left.

An unstable teleportation gate opened not far away, and Tolaen staggered out with lingering fear.

Fortunately, he had cast a teleportation spell in advance and avoided the barrage at the last moment. Otherwise, it would have been too embarrassing to be heavily injured before the battle even began.

"You actually ordered your fleet to bombard me without saying a word. Shameless!" Tolaen was shocked and furious.

How could a Beyond Grade A not give any face when visiting and challenging each other?

Even if my intention was to challenge you, you did not even say a word before bombarding me with a barrage of cannons. That's too rude!

The way he saw it, even if Beyond Grade As had grudges against each other, when one went to challenge the other, they would at least be polite on the surface. We're all people with status, but you directly blasted me out with a broom. Where is the etiquette between Beyond Grade As? This is not only embarrassing for me, but also for you!

At this time, Hella's voice sounded in the public channel.

"You've already lost to me. Those who have been surpassed by me have no chance of catching up to me. I'm not interested in fighting you again."

Hearing this, Tolaen was furious. He thought he was arrogant enough, but he did not expect Hella to be even more arrogant than him.

His expression changed several times, but he decided to endure it.

"Humph, I have a mission, so I won't argue with you. Anyway, you're basically a dead man."

Tolaen snorted coldly in his heart, activated a solidified magic communication rune, and contacted his teammates who were lying in ambush elsewhere.

Hella did not accept the challenge. Not only did she not fall for it, but she also shamelessly bombarded me with cannons. The plan to lure her won't work. Let's change to a direct attack. At least we've confirmed that she's in the stronghold. "

Very soon, Sagman's reply came through the magic communication.

"Okay, change of plan. Begin the attack! Tolaen, share your vision and locate her for us. Taylor, open the teleportation gate and attack the stargate first. Also, preheat the space stabilization device. After we enter, seal the hyperdrive and teleportation abilities, so Hella has no way to escape. We must act according to the original plan. "

…

Hella went all the way to the highest command room of the stronghold. Looking at the images transmitted back from the surveillance screen, she saw Tolaen in outer space constantly dodging the fleet's attacks.

"Why isn't he leaving? He is indeed plotting something."

Hella frowned slightly. After a moment of hesitation, she took out her communicator and sent a message to Han Xiao. She wanted to discuss this with Han Xiao.

However, in the next moment, a strong sense of danger suddenly arose, like a chill rising from his tailbone and penetrating deep into his bone marrow.

Hella's expression changed slightly. She suddenly raised her head. In her perception, several star-like energy sources suddenly appeared nearby.

"Warning! Warning! High energy source detected! "

"Warning! Warning! The Stargate has been destroyed. Requesting backup! "

The image on the screen suddenly changed. A magic teleportation gate suddenly appeared beside the stargate station far away, and two figures stepped out. They were Taylor and Sagman.

Before the defense forces of the stargates opened fire, the two of them attacked first without saying a word. A large number of summoned monsters surged out and blocked the defense fleet from every direction. Waves of arcane attacks with pure destructive power and endless beams of light shattered the stargates one after another as if they were rotten wood … The surprise attack was effective.

Beside Tolaen, a second super large teleportation gate appeared. The black mass of mechanical troops flowed out like a flood and spread out rapidly. The three figures at the front were Kasuyi's doppelganger, Desolate Beast Mercer, and 'Mechanical Catastrophe' Francisco's Lord's Avatar, who was controlling this mechanical army.

Kasuyi and Mercer were all old acquaintances. The one worth mentioning was Francisco, who was a direct descendant of Ethereal. He was a rather special existence. His main body had always been imprisoned in the Arcane Church and was usually not allowed to move around in the outside world. Only when the Arcane Church needed his strength would they allow him to use his Lord's Avatar in battle. If he performed meritorious deeds, his sentence would be reduced.

His crime was related to his nickname, Mechanical Catastrophe, which meant that he had once caused a machine-related disaster. At the same time, it was also an acknowledgment of his strength. He was an Energy Branch Mechanic and had a special talent. The cost of Mechanical Force bonuses was far lower than other Mechanics of the same level. At the same time, the range of his Mechanical Force was far greater than other Mechanics of the same level. This meant that the upper limit of the number of mechanical troops he could support at the same time was very high.

The purpose of bringing 'Mechanical Catastrophe' Francisco was to fight against the fleet of the army stronghold and restrain the mechanical troops that Black Star had placed there. He was responsible for the battle of the army. Otherwise, with just a few Beyond Grade As, most of their attention would be tied up by the fleet.

As soon as he entered the battlefield, Mechanical Catastrophe controlled his mechanical troops to fight against the fleet of the stronghold.

With the sudden appearance of the strong enemy, the stronghold fleet was caught off guard at first. They quickly adjusted, and the battle instantly entered the climax.

At the same time, Mechanical Catastrophe's troops also carried many spacetime stabilizing devices, wormhole countermeasures, and other equipment. All of them were activated, and 'bubbles' popped up, immediately stabilizing the spacetime of this area. This time, even teleportation spells could not be used.

Seeing this, Hila's expression immediately darkened, and her expression turned serious.

The enemy came prepared. Six Beyond Grade As, including a super combatant like Kasuyi …

They want to kill me so badly?

Even with Hella's strong personality, she could not help but be frightened by this.

Is this the situation that Black Star faced back then?

No, it might be even worse. It's practically a situation of certain death.

However, her mentality only wavered for a moment before Hella adjusted, suppressing the negative emotions and turning them into battle intent. She immediately felt as if all the blood in her body was boiling.

Boom!

The next moment, Hella broke through the roof, flew straight into the sky, gritted her teeth, and charged toward the few Beyond Grade As who had locked onto her with their aura.

During the charge, death energy was constantly released, turning into a bright red blood cloud.

Seeing this, Red Devil, Desolate Beast, and Mechanical Catastrophe's Lord's Avatar swooped down at the same time. While the defense fleet was distracted, they quickly bypassed the blockade and collided with Hella.

Boom!

The momentum was earth-shattering.

On the surface of the planet, a red shockwave exploded!

The blood cloud formed by death energy dissipated, and the red meteor fell to the ground at an even faster speed, unable to stop.

Rumble!

Along the way, she smashed a large number of bases, leaving behind a ravine-like trajectory. Only then did Hella stop her momentum, and dust filled the sky.

"Cough cough …"

In the dust, Hella got up. Her eyes were fierce. She casually wiped her bleeding nose and stared at the three people in the sky.

In a head-on clash, she was clearly unable to withstand the attacks of the three of them and was directly blown away.

At this time, in the distance of the stronghold, a small black dot rose into the sky like a black tide, quickly approaching from the distant horizon like a flock of crows covering the sky. It was the mechanical army that Han Xiao had placed in the stronghold, and the one leading was the Lord's Avatar that had already descended.

The next moment, a psychic wave that covered the entire planet descended, and an ethereal voice sounded in everyone's heart.

"Black Star, your opponent is me."

Their vision blurred, and they saw that Kasuyi's avatar had already blocked the path of the mechanical army. He raised a hand and pressed down.

Boom!

All the mechanical army was instantly pressed to the ground. Only the Lord's Avatar was glowing brightly with Mechanical Force, barely able to hold on.

"Although the opponent is a machine and can't use the psychic attack that psychic power is best at, I'm also proficient in psychic power."

Kasuyi's avatar said calmly, raised his hand, and pushed forward.

A psychic wall that spanned thousands of miles was formed and pushed forward with a rumble. All the buildings and machines in front of it were pushed out and pressed against the wall.

A portion of the mechanical army counterattacked toward the invisible psychic wall, but Kasuyi's psychic power seemed to be endless. Even though the psychic wall kept cracking under the focus fire, he did not mind squandering his psychic power to repair the damaged areas.

The psychic wall's momentum was almost unstoppable. Like a board eraser, it directly wiped out a large area of the planet's surface, uprooting a large piece of land. Countless building debris, soil, and machines were pushed into outer space along the direction of the psychic wall.

Other than the Lord's Avatar and a few mechanical soldiers with high mobility who took the initiative to retreat, the rest of the mechanical army was pushed out of the planet by the psychic wall, far away from the battlefield where Hella was. They could only regroup in outer space.

At the same time, Kasuyi's avatar also followed and blocked in front of Han Xiao.

"What terrifying psychic power." Han Xiao's Lord's Avatar's eyes flashed.

"I draw power from the Void Dimension. My psychic power is infinite. In terms of energy storage, perhaps only Oulou of the Radiant Federation can compare to me," Kasuyi said calmly. "I heard that you also have a Void Bloodline. When your God's Trait Transformation reaches a certain level, you might awaken such power."

Han Xiao's Lord's Avatar looked around and saw the entire battle.

At this moment, the planet stronghold could be divided into three battlefields. Hella was fighting Red Devil, Desolate Beast, and Mechanical Catastrophe. She was in danger and was completely at a disadvantage. One against three was too much for the current Hella, and it looked like she would be heavily injured at any moment. However, Han Xiao knew her well. Although Hella could not beat the three of them, she could still hold on for a short period of time. After all, her lifesteal ability was quite strong, and the power of reducing her lifespan was terrifying. It affected the enemy's performance and made them not dare to exchange injuries.

The second area was a large-scale army battle. The mechanical army controlled by Mechanical Catastrophe was fighting with the defense fleet of the stronghold. The battle was at a stalemate. The defense fleet mainly wanted to turn back and support Hila, while Mechanical Catastrophe's army was trying to pin them down.

The third battlefield was Sagman and Taylor. They were attacking the stargate station, cutting off Hella's path of retreat and the path of reinforcements. They had a huge advantage. When they destroyed all the stargates, they would turn back and attack Hella. By then, Hella would not be able to hold on.

Han Xiao's Lord's Avatar wanted to stop Sagman and Taylor, but there was still some distance between the stargate and the stronghold planet, so he would not be able to make it in time.

Furthermore, with the mechanical army in his hands, he probably would not be able to break through Kasuyi's blockade. The largest Mech Legion and Apostle Weapons were all with his main body and were rushing over. It would take a while for them to arrive.

The situation is not good … Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and looked at Kasuyi.

"You're determined to stop me?"

Kasuyi was expressionless. He retracted his mental waves and only had a one-way connection with Han Xiao. He slowly said, "This Lord's Avatar of yours has to stay here with me."

He emphasized the words' Lord's Avatar '.

Han Xiao observed Kasuyi's meaningful expression. Suddenly, he had an idea. He controlled the Lord's Avatar to charge forward with his mechanical army.

Kasuyi was a Psychic, but not only did he not fight back, he even charged forward to engage in close combat with the Lord's Avatar. The battle was very 'intense'. Those who did not know would think that there was some deep hatred between the two of them.

The mechanical army around them fired. Although the shots looked very accurate, they were actually using human marksmanship, so the cannon fire always brushed past them.

Kasuyi did not stop them and allowed these cannon fire to land on the battlefield between Hella and the three of them, interrupting the attacks of the three from time to time, forcing them to dodge and creating opportunities for Hella.

At the same time, the mechanical army spread out and tried to go around Kasuyi. Kasuyi symbolically released a psychic wall, but the strength of several places was clearly weakened and was easily torn apart, allowing the mechanical soldiers to pass through …

It looked like Kasuyi was fighting with the Lord's Avatar in close combat and could not divert his attention to maintain the psychic wall. This caused a portion of Black Star's mechanical army to take the opportunity to break through the blockade and support Hella.

Han Xiao finally confirmed that this guy in front of him was going easy on him …

No, this was not going easy on him. This was at least releasing a flood!

Why is he helping me like this?

Han Xiao's mind spun rapidly. Suddenly, he had a flash of inspiration. In the one-way mental connection, he whispered a secret code.

"Meeting of the Gods? Acting? "

"Focus. Acting."

Han Xiaoxin's head immediately froze.

Good lord, the boss on the other side is an actor!

Safe!

He temporarily suppressed his restless heart. The current situation could still be maintained.

He had already requested reinforcements from the dynasty. The stronghold's stargate might be destroyed, but the dynasty's reinforcements could go to the nearest stargate. Although they would not be able to reach his stronghold directly and would take more time to provide reinforcements, it would not be too slow.

"Ethereal has moved, so there might be other people watching. I have to calm down and adapt to the situation. Wait for reinforcements and my main body to arrive," Han Xiao thought to himself.

Under Kasuyi's guidance, a portion of the mechanical army successfully arrived at the battlefield where Hella was to provide reinforcements. With the Mechanical Force bonus from Han Xiao, the mechanical army was very strong. Even if there were not many of them, Tolaen and the other two could not ignore them.

With help, Hella immediately heaved a sigh of relief. She did not have to fight alone anymore, and her situation became much better. The mechanical army cooperated with her, and she knew when to advance and retreat.

The death energy that had the ability to reduce one's lifespan shot out everywhere, making Tolaen and Mercer extremely wary. Originally, both of them were tanks, but the one acting as the main tank was Mechanical Catastrophe's Lord's Avatar.

His fragile mechanical body was under pressure that this class should not have. Seeing how scared Tolaen and Mercer were, Mechanical Catastrophe Francisco was completely speechless.

Can you guys give me more strength? I'm not Black Star. My Lord's Avatar is not that tanky!

"Damn it, Kasuyi missed someone. Is Black Star's avatar that difficult to deal with?" Mercer was surprised as he dodged a round of attacks from the mechanical army.

"Kasuyi's avatar is here, after all. In order to split the battlefield, he released a powerful attack, so it's normal for his condition to deteriorate." Francisco's tone did not change at all. "I didn't expect Black Star to be so strong. Not only did he block Kasuyi, but he also has the strength to Virtual Invade my army."

On the other side, Red Devil Tolaen was just about to speak when his shield was suddenly shattered by cannon fire. He did not manage to dodge in time and was hit by Hella's death shockwave.

He immediately shivered and felt as if the message '-1' had popped up above his head.

Tolaen could not help but look up at Kasuyi, who was' fighting fiercely 'in the distance. His eyes were filled with resentment as he groaned in his heart.

"My lifespan has decreased again …"

…

"What … what's going on?"

In the outer space of the stronghold, in the battlefield where the fleets were exchanging fire, the army players in the battleships were dumbfounded by the sudden situation.

Although many players had already established or joined guilds under the name of the Black Star Corps and acted independently in the free competition zone in the form of subsidiary organizations, there were also some players who chose to follow the main force.

This was especially so after the Faction War Order issued by the army recently. Many players gathered at the frontline stronghold and treated this place as a temporary main city. They kept recruiting and forming teams, preparing to hunt down the players of the enemy faction in the free competition zone.

They did not expect that they would suddenly be attacked by multiple Beyond Grade As while staying in the Black Star stronghold. This place directly became the battlefield of eight Beyond Grade As!

What's going on? Aren't Beyond Grade As very rare? This is enough to fill up two tables of mahjong.

Could it be … we've encountered big news again?

Many players thought of the battle of Planet Lighthouse in the previous version and were overjoyed. They quickly turned on the recording function and took pictures of the faces of the Beyond Grade As.

"This is probably a big event in this version! We've encountered it! "

"Quick, take pictures. I have a feeling that something big is going to happen!"

Many players fully experienced the joy of being a spectator and were extremely excited.

…

The sound of hurried footsteps came closer and closer.

Bang!

The door to the reception room was knocked open. Ames, Silver Shadow, and Feidin, who were chatting in the room, could not help but turn their heads and look at the door. They saw Aurora stumbling in with an anxious expression.

"Teacher, something bad has happened!"

"What's wrong?" Ames was confused.

"Sis … Sister is being attacked by the Arcane Church. Many Beyond Grade As have gone there, and they all want to kill her. I saw it through telepathy!"

"What!"

Ames suddenly stood up. Her force field exploded, and the furniture around her was blown away.

After more than ten years of training together, she and Hella were already very close. Hearing that her student was in danger, Ames was furious.

At this time, a virtual screen appeared in the room. It was a call from an administrative officer.

"Your Excellency Ames, Your Excellency Fu Ding, something has happened. A Beyond Grade A called Traveler has visited Black Star Palace and challenged the Army Commander. How should we deal with this?"

"Tell him that His Excellency Black Star is not here," Fu Ding replied.

"… Er, he said that if Black Star is not here, he will fight the Lord's Avatar."

"Tell him that Black Star is very busy right now and has no time to fight him."

"… Your Excellency Fu Ding, he said that he can't come here for nothing. If he can't find Black Star, he can also challenge Her Excellency Dragon Emperor. This … he's a mage. If he doesn't leave, it'll be difficult to chase him away without some special means."

Fu Ding frowned and was about to speak.

At this time, Ames patted his shoulder and interrupted him. "This person is not here with good intentions. He probably has something up his sleeve. It might be related to Hella's matter. I'll go test him and tell him that he will accept the challenge."

Hearing this, Yin Ying, who had been silent all this while, felt that this was a good opportunity to build a relationship. If he helped Black Star's family, there would be great benefits.

Thinking of this, he stepped forward and volunteered. "Your Excellency Ames, how about I go?"

"How can I let a guest help me? Fu Ding, bring Your Excellency Yin Ying to the observation deck to watch the battle."

Ames waved her hand and turned around to leave the room. Her dress danced like a black flower.

Her tall figure disappeared from their sight, and only one sentence floated from afar.

"Don't worry, I'm not that easy to deal with."

—

Ah, without this chapter, I'm already a salted fish (′??)
